prompt: Ethers are generally UNREACTIVE in the lab compared to alcohols because:

options.label: No O–H bond; the C–O bond is strong; O is a poor leaving group as OR⁻.
The O has no lone pairs.

explanation: Ethers have no acidic H and no good leaving group. They're used as solvents (Et₂O, THF, dioxane) precisely because they're unreactive — just H-bond acceptors.
